title: Chameleon
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <g>
    <!-- tail curl -->
    <path d="M 22 62 Q 10 58 12 46 Q 14 36 24 38 Q 32 40 30 48 Q 28 54 22 52" fill="none" stroke="#3fbf6f" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="60" rx="24" ry="14" fill="#4fd67f"/>
    <!-- back ridge -->
    <path d="M 30 48 L 36 42 L 42 48 L 48 40 L 54 48 L 60 42 L 66 48" fill="none" stroke="#8cf5ae" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <!-- front leg -->
    <path d="M 62 68 Q 66 78 60 80" fill="none" stroke="#3fbf6f" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M 56 80 L 64 80" fill="none" stroke="#8cf5ae" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- back leg -->
    <path d="M 36 70 Q 32 78 38 80" fill="none" stroke="#3fbf6f" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M 34 80 L 42 80" fill="none" stroke="#8cf5ae" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- spots -->
    <circle cx="44" cy="56" r="3" fill="#8cf5ae"/>
    <circle cx="54" cy="64" r="2.5" fill="#2f9e58"/>
    <circle cx="58" cy="55" r="2" fill="#8cf5ae"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="66" r="2" fill="#2f9e58"/>
    <!-- head -->
    <path d="M 66 54 Q 78 46 82 54 Q 84 62 74 64 Q 68 64 66 54 Z" fill="#4fd67f"/>
    <!-- casque/crest -->
    <path d="M 68 50 Q 74 40 80 50" fill="#3fbf6f"/>
    <!-- eye -->
    <circle cx="75" cy="56" r="6" fill="#8cf5ae"/>
    <circle cx="75" cy="56" r="2.5" fill="#123a1e"/>
    <!-- mouth -->
    <path d="M 78 62 Q 82 63 85 60" fill="none" stroke="#2f9e58" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- tongue -->
    <path d="M 84 59 Q 92 54 95 46" fill="none" stroke="#ff5e8a" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="95" cy="45" r="2.5" fill="#ff5e8a"/>
  </g>
</svg>
